correctness.rationale: Two exhaustive face predicates agree on all 65,536 vertex masks; 13,568 directed nonempty Hasse incidences prove every matching acyclic; all five critical-pair cancellations have exactly one alternating gradient path, and the final signed integral 4-to-3 boundary vanishes. Discrete Morse plus the Hurewicz isomorphism proves the integral wedge; an independent full mod-two calculation checks Betti dimensions.
